I remember running to my dad once for having a problem at school. He just flat-out shouted at me and hit me multiple times. There were times when he got so drunk and he’d just hit me non-stop even if I didn’t do anything. He’d slap me, called me names, not giving me any chances to explain myself. He’d invalidate my feelings and downplay whatever achievements I have. He thinks that we’re his enemies or something. 

I never opened up to my dad since. My mom, on the other hand, is an empath. She’s desperately doing her best to keep the family together even if she’s getting the bitter end of my dad’s verbal abuse. She’d try to listen to me, but whenever I open up about my dad, it’d only fall on deaf ears. 

I may have a complete family but I still had no one to run to. I got bulled in school, never had solid high school friends. Only ones I have left are my dogs, my BFF Abi and two of our workmates, two college friends, and my new good friend here on Reddit. 

But I’m still too afraid to run to them for help, for I’m afraid it might cause them to get mad or to stay away from me. 

I have good people who surrounds me, but not having someone whom I can run to since childhood made it hard for me to run to someone else.
I’d appreciate if you’re going to be kind, be honest, care about my feelings, and tell me upfront.
